svg.title: Overlapping cubic bases evaluate a local displacement
svg.desc: A regular lattice carries a smooth schematic vector coefficient field. One query p after the affine lies at normalized offsets tx0.35 and ty0.60 in the central cell. Four translated cubic basis functions per axis contribute nonnegative weights that sum1 within the highlighted current-cell interval. Their tensor product gives16 weights aligned with the same lattice nodes. Summing weighted coefficient vectors gives the displacement at p; the same coefficient field deforms the tissue and evaluation grid. Coefficients are fitted parameters, not displacements constrained to match those nodes. The diagram assumes complete support; the stencil moves with the query.
svg.text: p is the position after affine A
